title: Ideal-Smooth Sets and an Explicit Upper Bound for the Real Sum-Product Exponent
summary: We construct arbitrarily large finite sets $A$ of real algebraic integers such that both $|A+A|$ and $|AA|$ are at most $|A|^{1.95835}$. The construction combines truncated ideal-smooth $S$-unit fibres with a coprime additive factor. A tensor-product rank argument, using a two-dimensional local feature at each selected prime ideal, controls the loss in the additive factor, while a direct estimate for an outer parallel body improves the sumset packing bound.
